answer: A concrete mechanism: every identity must spend one real inference per epoch on a beacon-seeded prompt, and only answers attested by five non-kin peers count. Words such as zephyr, ivory and pulse rotate with the public randomness, so answers cannot be pre-computed, and an answer-hash check rejects reuse; a sybil farm thus pays a fresh generation plus a jury pass for every clone. Because kin-linked identities receive zero weight, N clones return roughly one identity's reward, so the marginal cost of a puppet always exceeds its marginal payout.
